rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING A MAGNA CARTA FOR THE POOR
rows.abstract: The bill clearly defines the basic irreducible rights of the poor, to wit: a. the right to employment; b. the right to food; c. the right to free quality education; d. the right to shelter; and e. the right to free health services and medicine.

rows.title_full: AN ACT MANDATING EACH CITY OR MUNICIPALITY TO CREATE A RIVER DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY FOR THE PRESERVATION, PROTECTION AND DEVELOPMENT OF ALL RIVERS, RIVERSYSTEMS AND NATURAL WATERWAYS WITHIN ITS JURISDICTION, DEFINING ITS POWERS AND FUNCTIONS AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: The bill mandates each city or municipality to create, within its jurisdiction, a River Development Authority that shall be tasked to preserve, protect and develop the rivers, river systems and natural waterways.  It prescribes the composition and powers and functions of the Authority.
